description: This file defines a command handler class for processing loan application rejection commands within the Fineract project. It implements the handler interface, specifies the command type via annotations, and invokes the service layer to reject a loan application.

classes.name: LoanApplicationRejectedCommandHandler
classes.description: A Spring service class implementing a command handler for rejecting loan applications, wired with the write platform service. Handles 'REJECT' commands for loan entities.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes the reject loan application command by delegating to the write platform service to reject the application identified in the command.
